question: The Indus Water Treaty, which was suspended by India following the Pahalgam terror attack in April 2025, was signed between India and Pakistan in _______.
solution: The correct answer is __**1960**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Indus Water Treaty** was signed between **India and Pakistan** in the year **1960**. It was brokered by the **World Bank**. • The treaty governs the **utilization of the waters of the Indus River and its tributaries**, which flow through both India and Pakistan. • Under the treaty, the waters of the eastern rivers—**Sutlej, Beas, and Ravi**—are allocated to India, while the waters of the western rivers—**Indus, Jhelum, and Chenab**—are allocated to Pakistan. • The treaty ensures that Pakistan receives about **80% of the water from the Indus river system**, while India retains the remaining portion. • The treaty is often cited as one of the most successful examples of **water-sharing agreements** in the world, even persisting through periods of conflict between India and Pakistan.
